_meta.title: NOIZY DreamChamber — Cloudflare Access Application Policies
_meta.author: Robert Stephen Plowman (RSP_001)
_meta.purpose: One Cloudflare Access Application per internal service. Identity = perimeter.

applications.name: DreamChamber
applications.description: Multi-model AI command center. 11 providers, streaming, Three.js Contact Sequence, 9 agent personalities, C2PA credentials.
applications.accessibility_notes: Primary creative interface. Must support Voice Control + VoiceOver. 24h session non-negotiable — re-auth breaks creative flow for paralyzed operator.

applications.name: Voice Bridge
applications.description: Phone → Siri/Google Assistant → Power Automate → GOD.local. Voice commands from anywhere trigger actions on production machine.
applications.accessibility_notes: CRITICAL accessibility endpoint. Webhook bypass required — Power Automate relays from phone/Siri cannot do interactive auth. Service token for automated voice commands.

applications.name: Open WebUI (Ollama Chat)
applications.description: Web interface to 16 Ollama models including 10 custom NOIZY agents + gemma3. Chat from any browser.
applications.accessibility_notes: Browser-based AI chat. Works with VoiceOver. 16 models including all custom NOIZY agents.

applications.name: Ollama API (Direct)
applications.description: Direct Ollama REST API. Model inference, embeddings, generation. Used by DreamChamber, n8n workflows, and external tools.
applications.accessibility_notes: API-only endpoint. Service token enables DreamChamber → Ollama calls without browser auth.

applications.name: n8n Automation
applications.description: 18 automation workflows: GitHub→Gabriel, Stripe→Ledger, Voice→DreamChamber, health monitoring, consent kill switch, Notion sync, Linear sync.
applications.accessibility_notes: Webhook bypass required for inbound automation triggers (GitHub, Stripe, external services). n8n has its own auth layer.

applications.name: Grafana Monitoring
applications.description: Empire monitoring dashboards. Worker health, D1 query performance, consent token metrics, voice pipeline status, error budgets.
applications.accessibility_notes: Dashboard UI. Configure accessible theme with 44px minimum touch targets for iPad/iPhone viewing.

applications.name: Neo4j Knowledge Graph
applications.description: Knowledge graph database. Gabriel's memory, entity relationships, empire connected intelligence.
applications.accessibility_notes: Neo4j Browser is web-based. Works in any browser with VoiceOver.

applications.name: Qdrant Vector Database
applications.description: Vector database for embeddings. Voice fingerprint similarity search, semantic document matching, neural voice DNA comparison.
applications.accessibility_notes: API + Dashboard. Service token for programmatic access from DreamChamber and voice pipeline.

applications.name: RabbitMQ Message Queue
applications.description: Message queue for async operations. Voice synthesis jobs, consent validation queues, webhook delivery.
applications.accessibility_notes: Management UI is web-based. Standard browser access.

applications.name: Meilisearch
applications.description: Full-text search engine. Fast semantic search across empire documents, transcripts, and creative assets.
applications.accessibility_notes: API + mini dashboard. Service token for DreamChamber search integration.

applications.name: HEAVEN Dev
applications.status: NOT RUNNING — start with wrangler dev
applications.description: Local development instance of consent kernel API. Test new routes and migrations before production.
applications.accessibility_notes: Dev instance. Only runs when actively developing HEAVEN.

applications.name: Kubernetes Dashboard
applications.description: Kind cluster dashboard. Container orchestration for DreamChamber, audio pipeline, batch processing.
applications.accessibility_notes: HTTPS origin (self-signed cert). Cloudflare handles TLS termination, noTLSVerify for backend.

applications.name: SSH Terminal
applications.description: Browser-rendered SSH terminal to GOD.local. Full command line from any device. Cloudflare renders — no SSH client needed.
applications.accessibility_notes: Browser-based SSH terminal. VoiceOver compatible. Critical fallback when VS Code isn't available.

internal_only_services.name: PostgreSQL
internal_only_services.reason: Database — never exposed. Access through application layer only.

internal_only_services.name: Redis
internal_only_services.reason: Cache — never exposed. Internal to application stack.

internal_only_services.name: RabbitMQ AMQP
internal_only_services.reason: AMQP protocol port — management UI (15672) is exposed instead.

internal_only_services.name: Neo4j Bolt
internal_only_services.reason: Bolt protocol — Neo4j Browser (7474) is exposed instead.

production_edge_services.name: HEAVEN Production
production_edge_services.note: Cloudflare Worker — already at the edge. No tunnel needed.

production_edge_services.name: noizy.ai Landing
production_edge_services.note: Cloudflare Worker — already at the edge. No tunnel needed.

global_policy.reason: Accessibility hardware varies. Partial paralysis means adaptive devices that don't report standard posture. No lockouts.
